premises.text: 19th century technology is inadequate for powering 21st century mobile devices
premises.evidence_span: we're using 19th century technology to power 21st century mobile devices

premises.text: Over 90% of the energy transmitted by mobile devices is wasted
premises.evidence_span: over 90% of that energy is lost into the environment

premises.text: Nikola Labs' technology converts wasted RF energy into usable battery power
premises.evidence_span: converts radio frequency energy transmitted by mobile devices into extra battery power for that device

premises.text: The smartphone case can extend battery life by 30% using harvested energy
premises.evidence_span: we've been able to prove that we're able to extend your battery life by 30% simply using wasted energy transmitted from your phone

premises.text: The technology is a green solution that does not require plugging in
premises.evidence_span: our technology does not have to be plugged in to use

premises.text: There is a significant market for products that provide additional power to smartphones
premises.evidence_span: over 30% have purchased some sort of product to help them get a little more power in their phone

premises.text: The company aims to create a system of wireless powering products for various environments
premises.evidence_span: we'll be bringing wireless powering products to the market to give you what our dream is, and that is 100% mobility

premises.text: Low-power sensors can operate indefinitely using harvested RF energy
premises.evidence_span: low-power sensors that can live 100% off of our technology

value.text: Wireless power can become ubiquitous and provide extra energy for mobile devices
value.evidence_span: to truly make wireless power ubiquitous in our world

notes: Partnership with Ohio State and product launch details excluded as traction.
